37:        """Get the type of the iterable var.
38:

40:            The type of the iterable var.
41:        """
42:        return _determine_value_of_array_index(self.iterable._var_type)

96:    def render_component(self) -> Component:
97:        """Render the component.

99:        Raises:
100:            ValueError: If the render function takes more than 2 arguments.
101:            ValueError: If the render function doesn't return a component.
102:
103:        Returns:
104:            The rendered component.
105:        """

109:        from reflex.components.core.cond import Cond

117:        if len(args) == 1:
118:            # If the render function doesn't take the index as an argument.
119:            component = self.render_fn(arg)
120:        else:
121:            # If the render function takes the index as an argument.
122:            if len(args) != 2:
123:                raise ValueError("The render function must take 2 arguments.")
124:            component = self.render_fn(arg, index)

126:        # Nested foreach components or cond must be wrapped in fragments.

18:

20:class ForeachVarError(TypeError):
21:    """Raised when the iterable type is Any."""
22:
23:
24:class ForeachRenderError(TypeError):
25:    """Raised when there is an error with the foreach render function."""
26:
27:
28:class Foreach(Component):
29:    """A component that takes in an iterable and a render function and renders a list of components."""
30:
31:    _memoization_mode = MemoizationMode(recursive=False)
32:
33:    # The iterable to create components from.
34:    iterable: Var[Iterable]
35:
36:    # A function from the render args to the component.
37:    render_fn: Callable = Fragment.create
38:
39:    @classmethod
40:    def create(
41:        cls,
42:        iterable: Var[Iterable] | Iterable,
43:        render_fn: Callable,
44:    ) -> Foreach:
45:        """Create a foreach component.
46:
47:        Args:
48:            iterable: The iterable to create components from.
49:            render_fn: A function from the render args to the component.
50:
51:        Returns:
52:            The foreach component.
53:
54:        Raises:
55:            ForeachVarError: If the iterable is of type Any.
56:            TypeError: If the render function is a ComponentState.
57:            UntypedVarError: If the iterable is of type Any without a type annotation.
58:
59:        # noqa: DAR401 with_traceback
60:        # noqa: DAR402 UntypedVarError
61:        """
62:        from reflex.vars import ArrayVar, ObjectVar, StringVar
63:
64:        iterable = (
65:            LiteralVar.create(iterable).guess_type()
66:            if not isinstance(iterable, Var)
67:            else iterable.guess_type()
68:        )
69:
70:        if iterable._var_type == Any:
71:            raise ForeachVarError(
72:                f"Could not foreach over var `{iterable!s}` of type Any. "
73:                "(If you are trying to foreach over a state var, add a type annotation to the var). "
74:                "See https://reflex.dev/docs/library/dynamic-rendering/foreach/"
75:            )
76:
77:        if (
78:            hasattr(render_fn, "__qualname__")
79:            and render_fn.__qualname__ == ComponentState.create.__qualname__
80:        ):
81:            raise TypeError(
82:                "Using a ComponentState as `render_fn` inside `rx.foreach` is not supported yet."
83:            )
84:
85:        if isinstance(iterable, ObjectVar):
86:            iterable = iterable.entries()
87:
88:        if isinstance(iterable, StringVar):
89:            iterable = iterable.split()
90:
91:        if not isinstance(iterable, ArrayVar):
92:            raise ForeachVarError(
93:                f"Could not foreach over var `{iterable!s}` of type {iterable._var_type}. "
94:                "See https://reflex.dev/docs/library/dynamic-rendering/foreach/"
95:            )
96:
97:        if types.is_optional(iterable._var_type):
98:            iterable = cond(iterable, iterable, [])
99:
100:        component = cls._create(
101:            children=[],
102:            iterable=iterable,
103:            render_fn=render_fn,
104:        )
105:        try:
106:            # Keep a ref to a rendered component to determine correct imports/hooks/styles.
107:            component.children = [component._render().render_component()]
108:        except UntypedVarError as e:
109:            raise UntypedVarError(
110:                iterable,
111:                "foreach",
112:                "https://reflex.dev/docs/library/dynamic-rendering/foreach/",
113:            ).with_traceback(e.__traceback__) from None
114:        return component
115:
116:    def _render(self) -> IterTag:
117:        props = {}
118:
119:        render_sig = inspect.signature(self.render_fn)
120:        params = list(render_sig.parameters.values())
121:
122:        # Validate the render function signature.
123:        if len(params) == 0 or len(params) > 2:
124:            raise ForeachRenderError(
125:                "Expected 1 or 2 parameters in foreach render function, got "
126:                f"{[p.name for p in params]}. See "
127:                "https://reflex.dev/docs/library/dynamic-rendering/foreach/"
128:            )
129:
130:        if len(params) >= 1:
131:            # Determine the arg var name based on the params accepted by render_fn.
132:            props["arg_var_name"] = params[0].name
133:
134:        if len(params) == 2:
135:            # Determine the index var name based on the params accepted by render_fn.
136:            props["index_var_name"] = params[1].name
137:        else:
138:            render_fn = self.render_fn
139:            # Otherwise, use a deterministic index, based on the render function bytecode.
140:            code_hash = (
141:                hash(
142:                    getattr(
143:                        render_fn,
144:                        "__code__",
145:                        (
146:                            repr(self.render_fn)
147:                            if not isinstance(render_fn, functools.partial)
148:                            else render_fn.func.__code__
149:                        ),
150:                    )
151:                )
152:                .to_bytes(
153:                    length=8,
154:                    byteorder="big",
155:                    signed=True,
156:                )
157:                .hex()
158:            )
159:            props["index_var_name"] = f"index_{code_hash}"
160:
161:        return IterTag(
162:            iterable=self.iterable,
163:            render_fn=self.render_fn,
164:            children=self.children,
165:            **props,
166:        )
167:
168:    def render(self):
169:        """Render the component.
170:
171:        Returns:
172:            The dictionary for template of component.
173:        """
174:        tag = self._render()
175:
176:        return dict(
177:            tag,
178:            iterable_state=str(tag.iterable),
179:            arg_name=tag.arg_var_name,
180:            arg_index=tag.get_index_var_arg(),
181:        )
